summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, attaching a news release dated May 7, 2026, announcing the election of 13 director nominees at its annual and special meeting of common shareholders. The filing is a routine report of shareholder meeting results, with no transaction, price, premium, board recommendation, or structural deal terms. The vote tallies show all nominees received overwhelming support, with votes for ranging from 97.9% to 99.8%. As a standard post-meeting disclosure by a foreign private issuer, this filing does not trigger any special-situations category.
